uncertainty_notes: The profile improves source discovery process quality but does not guarantee that every future search will find all relevant sources.
Search engine result ordering and operator behavior can change, so agents must still record queries, access dates, and uncertainty.
limitation_notes: No search-provider API adapter or crawler was installed in this change.
The query-plan generator creates search plans; it does not execute searches or rank live results by itself.
